UNHCR operation in Libya (2024)

description.narrative: Cette activité montre les détails de l'opération du HCR en Libye pour 2024 et les années à venir, y compris le budget, les financements, les dépenses et les résultats. Pour plus de détails sur les objectifs de cette opération, merci d'utiliser le lien document "Strategy".

Libya remains both a major destination and transit country for significant groups of people in mixed movements. Instabilities in the wider region continue to push refugees and migrants who are embarking on perilous journeys to Libya and beyond. In particular, the onset of the conflict in Sudan has uprooted millions of Sudanese refugees, who continue to flee to neighboring countries in the region, including increasingly to Libya. Libya hosts over 60,000 refugees and asylum-seekers who are registered with UNHCR. The country also presents a complex displacement scenario, with 125,802 people displaced inside the country (IDPs). In addition, 44,000 people have been displaced since September 2023 when Storm Daniel struck eastern Libya. UNHCR continues to provide assistance and access to services for refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs and host communities, prioritizing registration, access to health, cash assistance and core relief items in urban settings. UNHCR continues to seek durable solutions, such as resettlement, evacuation, and complementary pathways, for refugees and asylum-seekers, with particular attention to people most in need. This activity shows details of the UNHCR operation in Libya for 2024 and future years including the budget, funding, expenditure and results. For specific details on the objectives of this operation, please use the document link "Strategy".

UNHCR's work is made possible by the generosity of its donors, including dozens of governments, hundreds of companies and their employees, and millions of private individuals who give directly or through UNHCR's National Partners.

Le HCR, l'Agence des Nations Unies pour les réfugiés, est une organisation internationale qui a pour mission de sauver des vies, de protéger les droits des réfugiés et de construire un avenir meilleur pour les réfugiés, les communautés déplacées et les apatrides. Pour des précisions sur les populations soutenu dans cette opération, merci d'utiliser le lien document "Populations".

UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency, is a global organisation dedicated to saving lives, protecting rights and building a better future for refugees, forcibly displaced communities and stateless people. For specific details on the populations supported in this operation, please use the document link "Populations".
